title: Pals Rewards Tenure and the Start of the Freight Delay Count
content:
**Loyalty team note - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, Large Item Freight Delivery.**

For the service-failure refund on a Large Item Freight Delivery order, the date from which the days the service-failure refund counts are counted depends on the whole months since the customer first joined Pals Rewards. The joining date is the enrollment date on the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership record.

| Whole months since the customer first joined Pals Rewards | The days are counted to today from |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | The order's placed date |
| 48 or more, but fewer than 96 | The date of the latest redelivery fee charged on the order |
| Fewer than 48, or no Pals Rewards membership | No change under this note |

**Whole months.** A month counts as whole once the day of the month of the joining date is reached again; a customer who joined on 20 May has completed 12 whole months on 20 May of the next year, and 11 on 19 May.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical joining dates)

| Joining date | Today | Whole months | Count starts from |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2018-05-20 | 2026-05-19 | 95 | Latest redelivery fee date |
| 2018-05-20 | 2026-05-20 | 96 | Placed date |
| 2022-05-20 | 2026-05-19 | 47 | No change under this note |
| 2022-05-20 | 2026-05-20 | 48 | Latest redelivery fee date |

### Example (hypothetical)

A customer who joined Pals Rewards 60 whole months ago has a freight order placed on 1 March, with redelivery fees charged on 20 March and 2 April. The days the service-failure refund counts run from 2 April, the latest redelivery fee, to today.
